name: aidoctor
description: Multi-language coding harness for AI agents. 8 skills orchestrate AI-slop review across any code: write-time prevention, diff review, whole-project audit. v1.0 ships deep rule packs for Python (25 rules) and React (19 rules, lifted from react-doctor MIT). LLM-only fallback for any other language. Same harness works in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode. JS / Rust / Go rule packs on the roadmap.
